tasks.AnalyzeNonFixedPoints: Analyze non-fixed points to find conditions for which f(f(x)) = x but f(x) ≠ x.
tasks.DefineFunction: Define the function f(x) = λx(1 - x).
tasks.DetermineLambdaValues: Determine the values of λ for which there exists an x in [0,1] such that f(x) ≠ x but f(f(x)) = x.
tasks.FindFixedPoints: Find fixed points of the function where f(x) = x.
